title: Session Lobby
description: A fully customizable, interactive landing page that players see whenever the session isn't running. Build it with the in-game Lobby Designer: hero text, party polaroids, quote bubbles, a live clock and countdown, now-playing music, and buttons that open journals, pages, actors, macros, links or pop-up notes. Includes an interactive World Map, a shared Party Vault (items + coins) and two themes: Clear Sky and Grimoire.

recommends.reason: Optional: lets you open shops for remote browsing from the lobby.
